19402416.fault: line 4 compares str to int so the branch is dead; line 16 unconditionally prints 20

57799532.fault: check() assigns r = r_copy locally and never returns it, so the decrement is lost; the greedy rewrite of r's digits to 5 can exceed r or drop below l
57799532.implementedAlgorithm: greedy digit rewrite of r toward 5..., helper check() to decrement digits

74821405.implementedAlgorithm: if len(r)>len(l) and len(r)>2: try i + '5'*(len(r)-2) for i in 1..99; else brute force l..r
